news.headline: Free train travel for everyone over 60 from Monday, insider reveals. Share before it gets deleted!
tells: Only an anonymous "insider" is quoted, and no official body.
No news outlet you know is reporting it.
It pushes you to share before it's "deleted": a pressure tactic.
Check the railway company's own website before you forward anything.

attacker_reveal: A nice free gift and a reason to hurry... and you spread the news for me. Next time, maybe you'll look for a second source before forwarding.
